english: to make sure to eat / eat properly
usage: Caring phrase to a loved one
Are you eating your meals properly?
examples: Even when busy, I always make sure to eat breakfast.
혼자 살면 끼니 챙겨 먹기 힘들어요.
When you live alone, it's hard to eat proper meals.
요즘 일이 많아서 밥을 잘 못 챙겨 먹어요.
I've been so busy lately I can't eat properly.
nuance: 챙겨 먹다 means to deliberately take care to eat (not skip meals), built from 챙기다 ('to look after') plus 먹다. 밥 잘 챙겨 먹어 is one of the warmest, most common things Koreans say to show they care, like a parent texting a kid. You'll also see it written without the space (챙겨먹다), but the standard spelling separates the two words.
mistakes: To show you care, Koreans say 밥 잘 챙겨 먹어 / 끼니 잘 챙겨 먹어요, not the stiff textbook 식사를 잘 하세요.
